summary_zh: 本地代码智能工具，通过MCP服务器把代码、文档、配置与基础设施连接成持久本地知识图谱，支持符号与语义检索、调用链和依赖追踪、跨Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform等基础设施关系追踪、变更影响分析与相关测试查找；附带可选的CBM Lens可视化界面。
audience_zh: 适合需要理解陌生仓库或大型代码库的开发者，以及希望通过MCP为编程智能体补充结构化上下文、在本地完成索引与查询的AI智能体用户。

evidence.quote: Local code intelligence for developers and AI agents. Connect code, docs and infrastructure in a persistent graph, with CBM Lens, MCP tools, agent integrations and change-aware test selection.

**Understand your repository, from source code to the systems around it.** codebase-memory-mcp is an MCP server that connects code, documentation, configuration, and infrastructure in a persistent local knowledge graph. Use it to find an unfamiliar feature, follow a call across services, trace a dep

Give your coding agent structural context through [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) (MCP), or query the graph directly from the CLI. **The MCP server is the core of the project.** Its optional visual companion, **CBM Lens, is in open beta (v0.0.1)**, with a source reader, ar

guration, skills, agent profiles, and applicable hooks. Indexing and graph queries need no hosted service or API key. Focused graph queries can reduce repeated file reads and token use; see the [measured results](#performance).
